register_map.notes: 8-bit pointer register selects internal registers; pointer is set by write command before read.

access_model.notes: Pointer register (8-bit) must be written before read; supports two-byte read for temperature registers.

steps.notes: Write pointer 0xFE, then read Manufacturer ID (expected 0x55).
Write pointer 0xFF, then read Device ID (TMP421=0x21).

operation_flows.notes: Read Manufacturer ID and Device ID to identify device variant. Canonicalized: removed non-read_channel outputs device_id, manufacturer_id; keep them as probe/status notes rather than public measurement outputs.

preconditions: Device is not in shutdown mode (SD=0) or one-shot triggered.

steps.notes: Poll BUSY bit (bit 7 of Status Register, pointer 0x08) until conversion completes. Max conversion time 130 ms per channel.

Write pointer 0x00, then read 2 bytes (high byte then low byte) from local temperature registers. Two-byte read returns both bytes from same conversion. Canonicalized from a multi-byte pointer read because output byte 'local_temp_high' maps to non-contiguous register Local Temperature High Byte.

transaction.notes: Canonicalized separate pointer read for non-contiguous output byte 'local_temp_low'.

steps.notes: Read non-contiguous byte 'local_temp_low' from Local Temperature Low Byte (0x10).

outputs.notes: High byte (1°C resolution) and low byte (0.0625°C resolution) combined.

operation_flows.notes: Read local temperature high and low bytes via two-byte read from pointer 0x00. Added poll BUSY step before read.

preconditions: Device is not in shutdown mode (SD=0) or one-shot triggered.

steps.notes: Poll BUSY bit (bit 7 of Status Register, pointer 0x08) until conversion completes. Max conversion time 130 ms per channel.

Write pointer 0x01, then read 2 bytes (high byte then low byte) from remote temperature 1 registers. Two-byte read returns both bytes from same conversion. Canonicalized from a multi-byte pointer read because output byte 'remote1_temp_high' maps to non-contiguous register Remote Temperature 1 High Byte.

transaction.notes: Canonicalized separate pointer read for non-contiguous output byte 'remote1_temp_low'.

steps.notes: Read non-contiguous byte 'remote1_temp_low' from Remote Temperature 1 Low Byte (0x11).

outputs.notes: High byte (1°C resolution) and low byte (0.0625°C resolution) combined.

operation_flows.notes: Read remote temperature 1 high and low bytes via two-byte read from pointer 0x01. Added poll BUSY step before read.

steps.notes: Write any value to pointer 0x0F to trigger one-shot conversion.
Wait for conversion to complete (max conversion time per channel).

operation_flows.notes: Trigger a single conversion in shutdown mode.

steps.notes: Write any value to pointer 0xFC to reset device.

operation_flows.notes: Reset device via software reset register.

steps.notes: Send general call address 0x00, then second byte 0x06 to reset.

raw_encoding.notes: Temperature data: high byte (8 bits, 1°C resolution) and low byte (upper nibble, 0.0625°C resolution). Combined as 12-bit signed value in standard range; extended range is unsigned with offset.

registers_or_commands.name: Configuration Register 2
registers_or_commands.description: Configuration register 2: channel enables and resistance correction.

registers_or_commands.name: One-Shot Start
registers_or_commands.description: One-shot start register (write any value to start conversion).

registers_or_commands.name: Software Reset
registers_or_commands.description: Software reset register (write any value to reset).

bitfields.name: LT[3:0]
bitfields.description: Fractional part of local temperature (0.0625°C per count).

bitfields.name: OPEN
bitfields.description: Open circuit fault flag for remote channel 1.

bitfields.name: PVLD
bitfields.description: Power valid flag for remote channel 1.

init_sequence.notes: Power-up defaults: Configuration Register 1 = 0x00 (continuous conversion, standard range), Configuration Register 2 = 0x1C (all channels enabled, RC enabled), Conversion Rate = 0x07 (8 conversions/sec). No explicit init required.
Wait for first conversion: BUSY bit asserts within 100 μs (TMP421) after power-up; conversion time per channel is 115 ms typical. Allow 130 ms per channel before reading.

read_sequence.notes: Set pointer to 0x00 (Local Temperature High Byte), then read 2 bytes (high byte then low byte).
Combine high byte (8 bits, 1°C resolution) and low byte upper nibble (4 bits, 0.0625°C resolution) into 12-bit signed value.

conversion_formulae.name: temp_standard
conversion_formulae.formula: T = high_byte + (low_byte >> 4) * 0.0625, where high_byte is signed 8-bit two's complement, low_byte upper nibble is unsigned fractional part.

inputs.name: low_byte
inputs.description: Low byte; upper nibble is fractional part (0.0625°C per count).

conversion_formulae.name: temp_extended
conversion_formulae.formula: T = (high_byte - 64) + (low_byte >> 4) * 0.0625, where high_byte is unsigned with -64°C offset.
conversion_formulae.notes: Canonicalized: exact compensation is preserved in formula/inputs, but the single-line integer expression was marked non-executable because it is too complex or not accepted by the safe expression evaluator.

conversion_formulae.name: eta_correction
conversion_formulae.notes: Complex compensation algorithm; driver must implement vendor algorithm.

conversion_formulae.name: eta_error
conversion_formulae.notes: Complex compensation algorithm; driver must implement vendor algorithm.

error_conditions.condition: I2C NACK during address or data transfer
error_conditions.detection: Bus error; SDA not pulled low during acknowledge clock pulse.

error_conditions.condition: Open circuit fault on remote channel
error_conditions.detection: OPEN bit (bit 0) in remote temperature low byte set to 1.
error_conditions.driver_action: Ignore temperature data for that channel; report fault.

error_conditions.detection: PVLD bit (bit 1) in temperature low byte set to 1.
error_conditions.driver_action: Ignore temperature data; report power fault.

error_conditions.detection: BUSY bit remains high longer than expected conversion time (130 ms per channel).
error_conditions.driver_action: Retry read; if persistent, report timeout.

power_states.name: continuous_conversion
power_states.description: Normal operation; device converts continuously at rate set by Conversion Rate Register.

power_states.name: shutdown
power_states.description: Low-power mode; all circuitry except serial interface disabled.

evidence_spans.snippet: The TMP421 supports nine slave device addresses
SD (bit 6) enables or disables the temperature measurement circuitry
RANGE bit (bit 2) of the Configuration Register
Negative numbers are represented in two's complement format
Manufacturer ID is obtained by reading from pointer address FEh
Device ID is obtained by reading from pointer address FFh
the temperature registers may be read as a 16-bit register by using a single two-byte read command from address 00h

requires_human: TMP422 address detection via transistor polarity at power-on requires careful PCB design to avoid incorrect address detection when remote transistors are on other ICs with lower supply voltage.
TMP423 has factory-preset addresses (A or B) that must be ordered correctly; no user address pins.
Conversion rate register values affect number of conversions per second differently depending on number of enabled channels; see notes in Table 7.
